description: Cargo.toml's [profile.dev] has no [profile.dev.package."*"] override, so cranelift-codegen, regalloc2 and object compile at opt-level 0 in the debug fz2 that the fixture matrix and CI run. On json_roundtrip's run door, Cranelift is 16.4% of the lane and SipHash frames attributed to cranelift_codegen and object another 22% of samples; nobody debugs those crates. Measure before deciding: build with `[profile.dev.package."*"] opt-level = 2` (dependencies only; the fz crates stay at 0 so debug assertions and debuggability are untouched), time the matrix single-threaded and the two slowest lanes, and report. Not a fix for fz-ex9 or fz-kdt.177; a lever that is free if the measurement says so.
title: Cranelift and its dependencies build unoptimized in the dev profile the fixture matrix runs
